mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% YoY and consumer sentiment (UMCSENT) is above its 12-month average, it signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% YoY and UMCSENT is above its 12-month average but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% YoY and the ISM manufacturing PMI (NAPM) is below 50, it signals a weakening industrial sector and potential economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 2% YoY and NAPM < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield (DGS10) rises by more than 50 basis points over 3 months and the Citi US Economic Surprise Index is negative, it signals a tightening financial conditions that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: DGS10 rises > 50bps in 3 months and CESI is negative but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCECC96) decline for two consecutive quarters and the University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index (UMCSENT) is below its 12-month average, it signals a weakening consumer sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PCECC96 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and UMCSENT is below its 12-month average but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
